newsitem.title: USA: Dow stuck lower, market quiets in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Dow stuck lower, market quiets in late trading.

text.p: Wall Street stocks drifted at sharply lower levels in late afternoon on Friday, with the market displaying little of the choppiness that marked the earlier part of the session.
The Dow industrials stood at 8065, off 123 points for the day and about halfway back from a deficit of more than 200 points during the depths of the afternoon sell-off.
The bond market remained mired near lows, amid concerns about inflation and rates ahead of economic data due next week. The long bond was down 1-13/32 to yield 6.63 percent.
